title: Chapter 628
paragraphs: Chapter 628
Episode 161. Return (5)
"You've already made an airship, the results are better than I expected."

"Except for a few test flights with Valeria, you're the first flight. Consider it an honor, I've created something the others couldn't even imagine! I'll be checking the aircraft, wait while sharing the stories you've missed."
"Understood."
The fastest way to Gwigok Saseong was to use the teleportation gate.
Gwigok Saseong was located in the Biment Empire, which owned the most teleportation gates in the world.
Furthermore, the current ruler of Biment was Subjeong Dante, so there were no procedural issues.
However, many changes had taken place in the world during the three years Jin was away.
"But wouldn't it be faster to use the teleportation gate?"
At Jin's words, Balkas shook his head.
Firstly, all the teleportation gates in the world had become useless.

"It's due to the chaos spread across the world, my lord. Originally, the risk of the teleportation gate would drastically increase only during heavy snow or rain, but now the chaos particles that are everywhere are playing that role."
"Also, all the factions have entered a cold war under the name of a ceasefire and have closed all connections. We can't use it anyway because of the chaos particles."
In addition, the airships, which were considered exclusive to Zifel until Grunil appeared, had now become quite common.
Not only Zifel and Kinzelo (as Jin predicted, they joined Zifel with the Eastern Empire) but also the royal family were operating several airships after receiving blueprints from them.
"If Mr. Kwall hadn't completed the airship, we would have had to travel by land or sea to Gwigok Saseong."

"He has completed more than ten airships so far, my lord. He has just smashed everything he made, calling it rubbish. If Goldbang did not have unlimited resources, Tikan would have gone bankrupt long ago."
"Anyway, he is a person who proves the common saying that a genius is eccentric."
There had also been dramatic advances in Zifel's biological golems, the royal family's Mains, and the artisans of Kinzelo.
The test subjects Jin saw in the desert were in a state of being eroded by chaos, and there were certain rules.
As Jin predicted at that time, each faction was enhancing the test subjects through their own 'chaos control'.
Kinzelo had the highest chaos control ability, followed by Zifel and the royal family.
However, each faction did not
accurately know each other's technological capabilities.
Balkas and Gilli alternately explained this.

"By the way, the thing I was worried about when I saw Zifel's fleet in the Sota desert happened exactly as I feared. It's a bit of a relief that the enemies haven't yet added a few ships of Cojeck or Grunil's level."
Unlike other factions, Runcandel was known to have only a few captured airships.
Although the Rainbow Bird confirmed the abduction of shipbuilders, they were unable to secure the key personnel.
Even if they had secured all the key personnel and the entire blueprint, finding engineers to manufacture it was another problem.
There was no progress at all regarding chaos control.
While terrible bio-golems and modified humans were rampant, it was commendable that they were still producing pure knights, but it was undeniable that Runcandel was falling behind the times.
'But the Prophet must have something prepared. If the family is already under the control of the Prophet, they're just hiding it...'
The blueprints and parts of the spacetime device acquired from the Sota Desert were still owned by Tikan, three years ago and now.
And Runcandel did not target Tikan even once while Jin was absent.
'If the gap due to technology is really serious, my mother would have pursued my colleagues, breaking our promise.'

Although Jin said he would complete the blueprint and the machine through the Daemon brothers, the research materials of Quaul were still supplied to Tikan, so it wouldn't have been difficult for Rosa to notice if she wanted to.
'But the fact that Tikan was never pressured means my mother judged it to be okay. Or... not my mother, but the Prophet.'
After the technology of each faction rapidly developed, Runcandel's external status was pushed to third place, following Zipple and Kinzelo.
That was clearly the perception of the saints. Some even rated Runcandel as a doomed family with only a limited time left.
"If such an evaluation was true, it seems like Zipple would have pressured Runcandel more aggressively, regardless of the truce."
"That's right, young master. The great powers are still avoiding serious friction with the family."
"They would be aware of the presence of my father and the Prophet."
There was still no news from Cyril's expedition.
At least, that's what Tikan knew.
"Did the Garden of Swords start controlling news about me half a year ago?"

"Yes, young master. Until then, they regularly published articles about your achievements and your reclusive training. It felt like imprinting the status of the next head of the family on both members of the family and the public. Now, even newspapers that are not affiliated with the family can't publish articles about you."
This was why his colleagues worried about Runcandel threatening Jin just before he came to Tikan.

It was not just media control. Since half a year ago, Runcandel had completely sealed off the city 'Calon', where the Garden of Swords is located, and completely hid the activities of the family's leadership.
That's why there were rumors that the fallen Joshua Runcandel was reinstated. Or rumors that Rosa usurped power while Cyril was absent.
"From what we've observed, after the lord left, a total of seven explosions and earthquakes were detected near Calon. We couldn't confirm whether it was due to a civil war or something else."
"The high probability is that it was due to the runaway caused by my mother's demonic transformation. If Tikan noticed seven, then surely there must have been many more."
It was difficult to guess the current state of the Sword Garden just from hearing the stories.

If Rosa had run amok making command unstable or a civil war had spread, other powers wouldn't have left it alone, if the gap in technology was serious they would have interfered with Tikan, and if Joshua had been reincarnated, it should have already been revealed.
None of those events were happening, which was making Jin more anxious.
The worst case would be this:

The prophet has already seized the family and its power is at a level that other forces fear, and the only reason Lundell has been protecting and neglecting Tikan so far is to verify and add the 'new information' that Jin will bring.
"...I'm sorry. We should have collected more information before you arrived."

"The world has changed much faster than I thought. I'm more than grateful that all my colleagues have survived without death or serious injury in it. Don't say such things, Balkas. You all did better than expected."
Really, Jin felt like a miracle that all his colleagues were safe in a rapidly changing world.

"Anyway, it would be best to reserve all judgment about the family until I see it myself. Depending on the situation, I'll have to either make more achievements during the remaining six months promised by my mother, or go straight back. First, we have to put out the urgent fire called Smarion Proc."
When the conversation went that far, Kwaul announced that the inspection of the machine was complete.
Following him to the shipyard and sortie in the middle layer of Tikan, Jin couldn't help but marvel repeatedly.
'The scale is not comparable to the shipyard in the Sota Desert, but anyone can see at a glance. The ships Kwaul is building far surpass the technology of Zipil at the time.'

Tens of thousands of gears, machines operating beautifully and intricately. In the middle of it, the first work that Kwaul didn't break down, showed off its graceful posture on a spacious space set up like an altar.
It wasn't a known large ship like Kojek, Grunil, or other mass-produced ships.
"It's a small ship."
"Yes. The boarding capacity is five people, and the only mounted firearm is an improved version of the mass-produced dragon spear of the royal family."
Kwaul said that the firepower of the flying ship was weak, but the dragon spear was the strongest weapon of the empire until the Sword Emperor's Palace.
It was only Kwaul who could reduce the size of the mass-produced dragon spear without performance degradation and install it on a small ship.
In the first place, only Kwaul could make a 'small ship'.

"But the performance of the built-in protection artifact is at a level comparable to Enya's Dragonfire Barrier. It's an artifact that Valeria and I made, the ultimate combination of magic and magical engineering at this time."
Kwaul's eyes turned red for a moment as he explained.
How many barriers of magic and magical engineering did it take to create this... At the moment of completion, even that Valeria was moved to tears.
"You've worked hard, Quaul. Here's a handkerchief..."
"Hmph, put it away. Just some ashes in my eye. Anyway, the official name of this airship is the Wave-Tracking Synchronous Space-Leap Ship. If I were to define it simply..."
"...You can't mean it's a ship capable of teleportation?"

"That's right. It's a device that overcomes all the drawbacks of the old-fashioned transportation portals. It requires a massive amount of power, which is a problem we'll have to solve going forward."
It was a hard story to believe, separate from Quaul's credibility, before experiencing it firsthand.
That's how shocking it was.
"Valeria and I have named it the Red Owl."
It seemed like a name Valeria came up with on her own.
"There shouldn't be a need, but there's a manual inside if an exceptional situation occurs. Try it out!"
Jin, Gilly, and Balkas climbed aboard the Red Owl with nervous faces.
"So we don't need to operate it ourselves?"

"I've set the arrival and return coordinates to Kwegoksaeseong and Tikan. When the launch pad opens, all you have to do is press the button in the center of the ship. You'll be in front of Kwegoksaeseong in the blink of an eye. And invisibility is still under development, so be mindful of exposure as soon as you arrive."
"Invisibility?"
"I don't know when it will be developed. Anyway, remember that if by chance the Red Owl is damaged, Valeria and I will do whatever it takes to kill you."
Thud...!
As Quaul opened the launch pad, an endless expanse of sky and sea came into view.
Jin cautiously pressed the button in the center of the ship and the Red Owl was enveloped in magic and began to vibrate for a moment, then the Red Owl began to charge with explosive acceleration.
Just as the 7th Order of Pirate King Cosmos did during his rookie days, or perhaps even faster.
Jin and his companions lost themselves for a moment at the ridiculous acceleration, and momentarily felt their heads go numb and their vision darken.
When they opened their eyes a few seconds later,
Jin and his companions were astounded by the desolate view of Kwegoksaeseong beyond the ship's window.
"...Really? Is this for real?"
Even seeing with their own eyes and experiencing it firsthand, it took a while to accept it as reality.
